title: suwgate.yml
description: The quality gate of a repository: its profiles, the steps it adds or skips, and the exceptions from the guards, each with its reason.

profiles.description: What the repository is; each profile brings its default steps and guards.

directories.description: Where a profile's project lives when it is not the repository root, e.g. web: Myapp.Web.

limitSeconds.description: The quick gate fails when it takes longer (default 20). SUWGATE_QUICK_LIMIT on a machine overrides it.

env.description: Variables set for every step (a step's own env in steps.configure wins).

unset.description: Variables no step sees, removed before the steps run, e.g. [Models__*, LLM_MODEL_*] so no step reaches a real model.

add.description: Steps this repository runs on top of its profiles' steps.

name.description: The step's id, unique among all steps.

run.description: A bash command, run in the repository root.

title.description: What the report calls the step.

quick.description: Also run it in suwgate check --quick (default false).

limitSeconds.description: The step is killed above this.

skip.description: Steps of the profiles this repository does not run, each with its reason.

configure.description: Knobs of the profiles' own steps, by step id: their ceiling, more steps to wait for, their environment, and the step's own settings, which the step's schema checks. Replacing a step's command is a skip with its reason plus an added step.

limitSeconds.description: The step is killed above this.

after.description: More steps that must finish first, on top of the step's own.

settings.description: The step's own settings, checked by the step's settingsSchema (README: the settings of the steps).

skip.description: Whole guards that do not apply to this repository, each with its reason: repository guards, and the .NET guards (architecture/*, database/*) that SuwgateGuards.VerifyAll runs and the dotnet-test step asks evidence for.

exceptions.description: Exceptions from the guards: one target of one guard, each with its reason. suwgate check counts them.

message.description: Narrows the exception to the target's findings whose message contains this text; without it, every finding of the target is excepted.

once.description: A one-time exception: it holds only while master's suwgate.yml does not have it yet (on the branch that adds it). After the merge it excepts nothing and is never stale; the report asks to delete it.

dev.description: What suwgate dev needs to run the local stack of the repository: db, logs, smoke, server, tmux, checkout-env.

name.description: The short lower-case name of the app: the tmux session is <name>-dev, the database user, password and name default to it.

portOffset.description: Added to every default port (server 6300, web 3300, e2e server 6301, e2e web 3301, database 5533, stack 8190), so repositories on one machine do not collide.

ports.description: One port set apart from the offset.

server.description: The dev server (dotnet watch), shown in its tmux pane.

web.description: The web dev server (pnpm dev), shown in its tmux pane.

e2eServer.description: The server of the browser tests in the main checkout.

e2eWeb.description: The web server of the browser tests in the main checkout.

database.description: The local PostgreSQL on the loopback.

stack.description: The web of the compose stack, where suwgate dev smoke looks.

profile.description: The compose profile of the database (default db).

serverService.description: The server service that suwgate dev logs --compose reads (default server).

extraServices.description: Services started and stopped together with the database (a mail catcher).

database.description: The app's database: user, password and name default to the app name; up and psql replace the compose service with the repository's own commands.

password.description: A development password: the database is published on the loopback only.

up.description: A bash command, run in the repository root, that starts the database (or leaves it running) and returns once it answers, e.g. scripts/.internal/db.sh up. suwgate dev db up, the database-up step and the e2e step run it instead of docker compose.

psql.description: A bash command that runs psql in the database as its owner and takes psql's arguments after it, e.g. scripts/.internal/db.sh psql. suwgate dev db psql and the e2e step use it instead of docker compose exec.

project.description: The folder of the server's .csproj (default: the folder of the one .csproj on Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web" in directories.dotnet, or in the repository).

logFile.description: The server's JSON log, whose folder suwgate dev logs reads (default .artifacts/logs/server.jsonl).

checks.description: The requests of suwgate dev smoke (default /healthz and /api/health).

expect.description: A regular expression the body must match on some line, next to status 200.

hint.description: What to look at when it fails.

settings.description: Settings of a guard, by its id; the guard's own schema checks them.

reason.description: Why: a sentence a reviewer can judge.

env.description: Variables set for the commands, by name; quote a value YAML would read as a number or a boolean ("1").

unset.description: Variables removed from the environment, by name; * and ? match any characters (Models__* clears every Models__ setting), without regard to case, as .NET reads configuration.
